Method of Attack: Configures itself to start on login via Windows Registry entry
Injects into running processes such as Chrome browser
Uses Windows Message Queuing protocol (MSMQ) over HTTP to communicate with Command & Control server
Scans drives for specific file types (INP, SQL, PDF, RTF, TXT, XLSX, XLS, PPTX, PPT, DOCX, DOC)
Uploads detected files to Command & Control server
Modifies permissions of C:\Users\[username]\uninst.dll to restrict access
